info.name: Lookup fungible token contract IDs for an account

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional API key forwarded by embedded portal clients. The public FastNEAR API does not require it.

items.docs: Fetch the fungible token contract IDs an account has held — contract IDs only, no balances.

info.name: Lookup indexed fungible token rows for an account

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional API key forwarded by embedded portal clients. The public FastNEAR API does not require it.

items.docs: Fetch an account's fungible token balance rows, each with contract ID, balance, and last-update block height.

info.name: Lookup top indexed holders for a fungible token

params.name: apiKey
params.description: Optional API key forwarded by embedded portal clients. The public FastNEAR API does not require it.

items.docs: Fetch the top-balance holder list for a fungible token contract, ranked highest balance first.
